result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it provides up to six months of post-expiry or termination transition assistance at then-current rates, preserves return of Customer Data within 30 days of request in a complete machine-readable format, and requires secure deletion followed by officer certification. The revision is appropriately confined to replacing the conflicting immediate-cessation and deletion language in Section 11.1, while preserving the more detailed and protective data-return and deletion provisions in Sections 11.2 and 11.3. The drafting is clear, internally consistent, and professional.
